# PDF.js

Mozilla PDF.js **6.3.289**, from the official distribution:
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.3.289

Only the display library, worker, supporting character maps/fonts/decoders/color profiles, and license are included. Files are served locally by this site; selected documents are never sent to a third-party preview service.
